headline: Aviation breakout hits 17,517.5x as five more niches get a full sample
paragraphs: Biggest score moves since yesterday: motivation 13 to 86 (5 to 40 channels) and top-10-facts 55 to 86 (6 to 34). Reddit-stories rose 81 to 89. Newly scored: robotics-humanoids 83, sleep-ambient 82, lofi-study-music 79, no-code-automation 78. These reflect larger samples, not a market shift.

Top breakout: TALEYE's Florida Learjet 60 video in aviation, 17,517.5x its channel's typical views (4,414,405 views, 3,750 subscribers). Axiom Void's Voyager 1 video hit 2,133.9x with 735 subscribers. Lofi multiples up to 61,249x come from tiny baselines; treat them as provisional.

Added three niches to track: retirement-planning, coding-tutorials and hands-only-crafts, taken from 2026 roundups (OutlierKit, Opus), not this week's data. Thumbnails did not load, so only 2 channel verdicts, no thumbnail tags, and titles-only niche notes.
